name: Can I replace a smaller window with a larger picture window?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace a smaller window with a larger picture window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to replace a smaller window with a larger picture window. This often involves structural modifications to the wall opening, which may require framing adjustments, lintel installation, and potentially a permit. While this expands views and light, it adds complexity to the project. Hometelligent will assess your home's structure and advise on feasibility and requirements for such an alteration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, replacing a smaller window with a larger picture window is possible but often requires structural modifications and may need a permit.
